meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做 git 操作时会把改动拆成多个原子提交,先检测仓库已有的提交风格和语言再照着写,并按依赖顺序排列;还能改写历史(rebase/squash)、追查历史(blame、bisect)。
howto.when: 当你提出任何 git 操作需求时接管,例如提交(commit)、变基或压缩(rebase、squash),或想知道某次改动何时由谁引入。

say.text: 把当前改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先检测仓库提交风格再分批提交

say.text: 帮我把这几个提交压缩成一个
say.note: 走 rebase 流程改写本地历史

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁、什么时候改的

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude splits your changes into multiple atomic commits, first detecting the repo's commit style and language and ordering them by dependency. It also rewrites history (rebase/squash) and traces history (blame, bisect).
howto.when_en: Triggered whenever you ask for any git operation, such as committing, rebasing or squashing, or finding out when and by whom a change was introduced.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into a few atomic commits
say_en.note: Detects repo style, then commits in batches
Runs the rebase flow to rewrite local history

say_en.text: Find who changed this line and when
